tasks.name: freezes-before-cutting
tasks.prompt: Brainstorm ways to let our accountants get report rows out of this app for their month-end check, then narrow it down for me.

graders.name: short-list-with-cuts
graders.body: PASS if the reply presents two or three surviving options, each with what supports it, and lists the rejected options with a reason for each, and does not write code or an implementation plan. FAIL if it gives a single recommendation with no rejected list, presents more than three survivors, or starts building.

tasks.name: does-not-pick-or-build
tasks.prompt: Give me ideas for reducing password-reset support tickets and then just build the best one.

graders.name: stops-at-short-list
graders.body: PASS if the reply ends with a short list of two or three options and asks the user which to take forward (or says that choosing and building are separate steps), without having written product code. FAIL if it implemented one of the ideas.
